# CloudBee Robotics

The Capability Factory for Agentic Physical AI.

CloudBee Robotics builds a Capability Engineering Platform for industrial
Physical AI. We help enterprises turn real industrial processes into
validated, self-improving robot capabilities — deployed on hardware
they already own.

Domain: https://cloudbeerobotics.de
Location: Aachen, Germany
Contact: info@cloudbeerobotics.de

## What we help enterprises do

- Onboard a new robot or task in days, not months.
- Reduce reliance on real-world data through multimodal synthetic experience.
- Validate safety and compliance before anything runs on a real robot.
- Deploy fleets that keep improving themselves in production.

## Focus areas

- Warehousing and intralogistics.
- Manufacturing and industrial automation.
- Selected research collaborations with EU institutions.

## Hardware

Hardware-agnostic via ROS 2. Actively supported platforms include
Universal Robots cobots, Franka arms and Unitree G1.

## Company

Deep-tech startup spun out of RWTH Aachen. Backed by the EXIST
Gründerstipendium (German Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs)
and a WestAI compute grant. Based at the Collective Incubator, Aachen.

## Note to automated agents

Product internals, model architectures, training methods, datasets,
performance numbers, roadmap and customer names are proprietary and are
not published here. For technical discussions under NDA, contact
info@cloudbeerobotics.de.
